text:
jamie: Quick heads-up — planning enable of nebula-4b-q@v2.1.0 (quant) in the model catalog. Target change window Tue 2026-04-07 03:00-05:00 UTC. Need fallback ordering and pin strategy for NA/EU. Any objections?

alex: No objections. Suggest pin to v2.1.0 for 48h, then progressive unpin. Also require canary at 1% for first hour.

monica: Can ops deploy bot schedule? Also confirm inference profile — latency tight, prefer lower-burst batch settings.

deploy-bot: change scheduled: 2461234567 | channel=eng-releases | window=2026-04-07T03:00:00Z..2026-04-07T05:00:00Z | by=@alex

alex: Canary plan: NA first 03:00-03:40 (1%), EU 03:40-04:20 (1%), global ramp 04:20-05:00 (to 30%). Rollback criteria: 99th pctl latency +30% OR error rate >0.5% OR quality regressed on eval set (alert tags: eval-cat/nec)

devex_taylor: Adding release notes snippet and README update. Will include prompt sets used for eval.

sre_oncall: I'll be monitoring latency. If we see degradation I'll initiate rollback. Will attach evacuation playbook.

alex: Fallback ordering for the catalog entry — patch snippet:
```
model_id: nebula-4b-q
pin: v2.1.0
fallback_order:
  - nebula-4b-pt
  - comet-7b
  - small-lumina-3b
```

monica: Also add 'quant-safe' tag so routing avoids aggressive autoscaling for first 24h.

pm_maya: Product OK, add note in release notes: 'Improved cost/latency tradeoff for conversational API with nebula-4b-q'

alex: Ops checklist before window:
- push catalog patch (PR created)
- deploy-bot schedule confirmed
- qa eval run ✅
- preflight traffic drain configured
- alert dashboard pinned

jamie: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/412 — reviewers @monica @alex

monica: Reviewed, left minor nits. Approving once tests pass.

deploy-bot: deploy check: preflight OK, canary targets applied, monitoring hooks injected.

sre_oncall: Oncall note: if rollback, use command `rwdctl catalog rollback nebula-4b-q --to v2.0.4` and call @sre_oncall + @alex. I'll post incident channel template if invoked.

jamie: Thanks all. We'll proceed with the change window. Will post a short release note in #announcements after cutover :tada:
